name: Adventurers
note: Fey and Fey Quickness are the Elf's; Ferocious Charge the Barbarian's and the Dwarf's; Magic Resistant, Monster Slayer and Berserker the Dwarf's.

name: Animal Aspects
note: Wood Elf heroes only. No more than two heroes in a warband may hold the same Aspect.

name: Call of the Night Haint
note: Spirits only.

name: Dwarf Grudgebearers
note: Monster Hunter, Set Traps (Dwarf Grudgebearers) and Infiltration are the Ranger's; Expert Runesmith the Runesmith's.

name: Goblin Raiders
note: Hit and run is any Hero's; Beast tamer needs the Beastmasta Nitch and Infiltration the Nasty Skulker Nitch.

name: Halflings (MIC)
note: Stealthy: the Halfling Thief only.

name: Holy
note: Path of The One (Preacher) and Path of Sigmar (Holy Vow) path-takers only

name: Knights Feats
note: In a Bretonnian Brigand warband only the Fallen Noble learns these; among the Disciples of Maldred only an untainted Questing Knight, who keeps any he has once corrupt.

name: Knights of the Bitter Moors
skills: Virtue of Valour (Knights of the Bitter Moors)

name: Large Special
note: A Large warrior knows one Large skill at a time: learning another forgets the first.

name: Lizardmen (Lustria)
note: Infiltration (Skink) and Great Hunter are for Skinks only; Bellowing Battle Roar and Toughened Hide for Saurus only.

name: Lothern Sea Patrol
note: Infiltration: a Hero with the Ranger honour and a promoted Sea Ranger only.

name: Necrarchs, the Soul Stealers
note: The Thrall may learn these only once he is a Wizard.

name: Ogre Hunting Party
note: Ogres only: Maneater, Bull Charge. The leader only: Bellowing Roar (Ogres). Gnoblars only: Infiltration, Set Traps.

name: Sartosa Pirate Skills
note: A hero may know only one of these at a time; Pistol Expertise doesn't count towards that limit. For a promoted henchman it takes up no skill list.

name: Savage Orcs
skills: The Power of Man's Red Flower

name: Silent Brotherhood
note: Master of Poisons: Poisoner only.

name: Skaven Clan Skryre (Athel Loren)
note: Infiltration: Stormvermin only. Skavenbrew Master: Warlock Engineers and Warlock Apprentices only.

name: Slayer Cult
note: Songster: the Rememberer only. Deathwish: Stubbles and Axe Hurlers who become Heroes.

name: Slayer Pirates
note: Deathwish: Landlubbers and Gunners only.

name: Undead Vampires
note: Vampire only

name: Vampire Hunters of Sylvania
note: Iron Will and Righteous Aura: the Vampire Hunter and Slayers only.
